text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O received tickets to the 
amusement park, so I came along with her 
to hang out, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is it you who rejoices, or the 
attraction itself?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for an attraction to bear the "Supreme 
Overlord" such as myself must surely be 
its greatest honor.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The elated swan boat takes flight into the 
sky— and the roller coaster, bursting with 
joy, might just go through a few more 
loops than usual...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, if it comes down to it, I'll 
handle it somehow.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, why don't we start by enjoying 
the nearest attraction!

T.M. Opera O and I entered the nearest 
building. There, we found—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! Gah, stop it...! This can't be 
happening... Aaaah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How terrifying...! Trainer, quick... you 
have to get out of here first...!

"Supporting T.M. Opera O after she fell to 
her knees, I desperately made our escape 
from the building."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...I lost my composure. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I never could have imagined it. To think 
that everything in this room—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To think it was covered in mirrors!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So that was a house of mirrors... My eyes 
were nearly scorched by my own brilliance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by so many of me... Trainer, I 
am so sorry!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your eyes... Are your eyes all right!?

It seems T.M. Opera O is genuinely 
worried...
choice_data_list: We somehow managed to endure it.

text_block_list.text:
It seems T.M. Opera O is genuinely 
worried...
choice_data_list: We somehow managed to endure it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded though you were by my beautiful 
form, you supported me and helped me out 
of the building...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The power of your will to save me, is 
it...? Good grief, you never cease to 
amaze me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, you pushed yourself that hard. 
Aren't you exhausted?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're so kind.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Please, let me treat you today. Why don't 
we take a relaxing ride on the Ferris 
wheel?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And for just a brief moment, I shall let 
you reflect me in your eyes...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, behold! My beautiful profile gazing 
upon the earth from above!

No matter what pose T.M. Opera O struck, 
she didn't budge an inch inside the Ferris 
wheel. ...What incredible core strength.

Though I wondered if Ferris wheels weren't 
meant for enjoying the scenery, I found 
myself completely swept up in her lively 
demeanor.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, you stared at the floor, did you? I 
think that was a wise decision.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That kind of split-second judgment must be 
an essential skill for a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... For this once, I should take a 
page from your book.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this was entirely my mistake. I 
have to do something to apologize..."
choice_data_list: You don't have to worry about it.
You don't need to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: No, that won't do!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Oh, I know! Come with me, Trainer-kun!

Hurrying after T.M. Opera O as she ran, 
there, floating on the lake, was a boat—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Come, feast your eyes to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Surrendering myself to the drifting 
boat... Behold a beauty so radiant, no 
painting could ever capture me!!

In contrast to the leisurely moving boat, 
TM Opera O strikes one pose after another.

What was supposed to be a slow and 
relaxing time turned into a speedy and... 
rather unique experience.
